note.description: User provided additional text about this transaction

currency.description: The currency that this transaction was handled in

amount.description: The value in the base unit of currency that this transaction was charged at

vendor_currency.description: The currency this transaction was created

vendor_amount.description: The value in the base unit of currency that this transaction was charged at by the vendor

status.description:
* capture: Deducting purchase amount from account balance
* precapture: Funds reserved due to card usage
* refund: Refunding the purchase amount back to account balance

authorization_status.description:
* reversed: Previously approved and held funds have been released
* pending: Funds have been approved for a transaction and are currently held
* closed: Look at `status` for more details, the authorization is no longer relevant

authorization_datetime.description: The date that this transaction was initially authorized at

transaction_datetime.description: The date that this transaction was captured

allocation_datetime.description: The date that this transaction was allocated to a fund

card.description: The card this transaction was created with

receipt_attachments.description: User provided images of receipts about this transactions

fund.description: The fund this transaction is allocated to

account.description: The chart-of-accounts entry assigned to this transaction by the cardholder or reconciler/accountant. Null when no account has been assigned.

type.description:
* spend: A transaction that has occurred on the issuing network
* credit: A transaction about allocating fund usage from selecting a fund in Procurify

reconciliation_status.description:
* pending: Transaction has not yet been reconciled
* reviewed: Transaction has been reviewed during reconciliation

linked_authorization.description: Any transactions which share the same linked_authorization value are part of the same lifecycle for a transaction

custom_fields.description: A list of any custom fields provided for this transaction
